ud7.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud7.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Lakuṇṭakabhaddiyo sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami.
ud7.5:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭakabhaddiyaṃ dūrato 'va sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddassikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpaṃ,
ud7.5:3.1: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ bhikkhuṃ dūrato 'va . . . pe . . . paribhūtarūpan ti.
ud7.5:4.1: eso bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo, na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā, yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā,
ud7.5:4.2: yassa c' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī 'ti.
ud7.5:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
